epics.title: Threshold override screen
epics.objective: PCMH coordinators can override program thresholds in Acme Claims instead of emailing the analyst. Each override is saved with who made it and why.
outcomes: An override is saved and shows on the member record
Every override writes an audit row
Coordinators no longer email thresholds to the analyst

epics.title: Program year filter
epics.objective: Analysts can filter Member Journey and the reports by program year, so month-end reviews no longer need an Excel export.
outcomes: Choosing a year shows only that year's members
The filter is kept when moving between pages
questions: Which release should this go in? Q1 2027 has Acme Claims 2027.1 (February) and 2027.2 (April).
